CGM image rendering in Author mode

body.p: offers a few add-ons that provide support for CGM 1.0 images. To allow the rendering of CGM images in Author mode, follow this procedure:

ol.li: Go to Help Install new add-ons to open an add-on selection dialog box.
Enter or paste in the Show add-ons from field or select it from the drop-down menu.
Select the Oxygen CGM support add-on and click Next.
Select the I accept all terms of the end user license agreement option and click Finish.
Install version 28 or later in an Eclipse environment.

ul.li: CGM image support is enabled by default in the S1000D publishing scenarios.
CGM image support can be enabled in DITA PDF output by adding the required libraries to the FO processor.
